summary: The global O(epsilon^{-3}) KKT theorem passes, but the local O(epsilon^{-2}) corollary is invalid for the split algorithm.

issues.note: The local corollary replaces the split direction mu^k+bar-rho(A(x^k)-y^k) with the reduced direction mu^k+bar-rho A(x^k); a one-dimensional fixed-point counterexample invalidates the claimed local rate.
